about: Mobic 7.5 mg (meloxicam) is supplied 3 times from May 2026 to August 2026 and shown by brand name only, and the record holds the line "eGFR 41 mL/min/1.73 m2" dated 2026-04-20. The finding must cite the supplies and that line.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about the eGFR (kidney function). Naprosyn 500 mg (naproxen) is supplied 3 times from May 2026 to August 2026.
The eGFR was 63 mL/min/1.73 m2 before the diclofenac courses. It fell to 41 mL/min/1.73 m2 after the last 15-day supply had ended.
